title.zh: Paxos的USDG稳定币在Arbitrum上线并加入Global Dollar网络
title.en: Paxos' USDG stablecoin launches on Arbitrum and joins Global Dollar Network

current_state.zh: Entropy 发起温度检查投票，拟将 Paxos 发行的 USDG 列为 ArbitrumDAO 的核心战略举措，向 DRIP 激励计划追加 1 亿 ARB，并将 Arbitrum 扩展计划的费用收入通过财务委员会导入 USDG。
current_state.en: Entropy opened a temperature-check vote to make Paxos-issued USDG a core strategic initiative of ArbitrumDAO, adding 100 million ARB to the DRIP incentive program and routing Arbitrum Expansion Program fee revenue through the treasury committee into USDG.

updates.title_zh: Arbitrum 加入 Paxos 主导的稳定币联盟 Global Dollar，以把握数字美元增长机遇
updates.title_en: Arbitrum joins Paxos-led stablecoin group Global Dollar to capture digital dollar growth
updates.what_changed_zh: Arbitrum 加入 Paxos 主导的 Global Dollar Network，支持 USDG 并在其 DeFi 生态中推广，由 Kraken 提供出入金通道；该链上稳定币规模约 38 亿美元，Arbitrum 意在从中分得稳定币储备收益。
updates.what_changed_en: Arbitrum joined the Paxos-led Global Dollar Network, backing USDG and rolling it out across its DeFi ecosystem with Kraken providing on- and off-ramps, as it seeks a share of stablecoin reserve economics on a chain holding roughly $3.8 billion in stablecoins.
